scientific_integrity: Theorem includes an all-integer proof. The extracted numerical checker supplements but does not replace proof; same-model review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Equal price for all sunlet edges, unit total conductance budget, symmetric ordinary Laplacian, connected support, n>=3. Not a constant-factor gap: relative regret vanishes. Does not cover nonuniform masses or prices, general coronas or other dynamic gains. Publication priority is qualified by bounded literature searches and no independent review.
title: Second-order coherence on sunlet networks: a cubic allocation law and a strict first-order mismatch
